question: Why does this function crash?
imageDescription: A TypeScript function cartTotal(items) with "for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++) { total += items[i].price; }"; a note says it crashes on every cart.
mustInclude: the loop uses <= items.length, so it reads one past the end (an off-by-one)
items[items.length] is undefined, so reading .price throws
the fix: use < instead of <= (or a for...of loop / reduce)
mustNotInclude: a different cause for the crash
